parsedVerdict.reasoning: AppointmentsController sits in the presentation layer. Most of what it does fits that role: it maps form fields to service arguments, parses the date string, hands work to SchedulingService and VisitNotesService, and formats results with the presenter. The exception is book(), which checks that a visit lasts between 10 and 120 minutes and throws the business SchedulingError('rejected', ...) if it doesn't. That is a scheduling rule about the appointment itself, not a check on the request format. It belongs in the domain layer, in SchedulingService or the Appointment entity. Because the rule lives in the controller, it is skipped by any other caller of SchedulingService.book, and the domain no longer owns its own invariant. cancel() and addNote() only hand off work and shape output, which is fine for this layer.
